instructions.title: WEBSITE GUIDELINES
items: All sections are clearly marked with titles, making it easy to find the information you need.
The most important details are visually highlighted based on their relevance.
Hard skills are presented as cards that can be toggled using arrow buttons.
Most hard skills include related projects — clicking on them opens the corresponding project page.
If you see a small triangle icon, it means additional info is available for that item.
All of my projects are listed at the bottom of the page and displayed as cards with navigation arrows.
This website is built using React.

personal_statement.title: PERSONAL STATEMENT
personal_statement.text: Self-motivated Software Systems Development student with hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience at Google and a strong foundation in full-stack application development, backed by several completed and deployed projects. Passionate about back-end development, database management, and process automation. Experienced in backend system integration, low-level telemetry, and large-scale environments, with proven ability to navigate the entire software production lifecycle, from technical design documentation to live monitoring in production.

text.title: Problem Solving & Incident Management
text.description: Demonstrated ability to Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and isolate edge-case infrastructure bugs. Solid foundational problem-solving skills (3rd place in Kharkiv regional Olympiads in Informatics, Math, and Physics).

text.title: Technical Communication & Writing
text.description: Proficient in writing end-to-end technical documentation, coursework applications, and system specs. Experienced in presenting and defending projects under critical opposition (2nd place in All-Ukrainian Tournament of Young Inventors).

text.title: Teamwork & Collaboration
text.description: Adept at working in agile engineering teams and Google-scale environments. Proven track record in ideation and identifying logical code bugs under deadlines (2nd place in city CS tournament).

text.title: Adaptability & Analytical Thinking
text.description: Quick learner capable of mastering new tech stacks and internal tooling on the fly, backed by a strong mathematical foundation for algorithmic problem solving.

text.title: Leadership & Project Ownership
text.description: Proactive approach to end-to-end task ownership. Demonstrated organizational skills as a class representative at school, steering team workflows and organizing events.

text.title: Languages
text.description: Native in Ukrainian and Russian. Professional proficiency in English (C1) for technical documentation, code reviews, and international team communication.

text.title: Go & Distributed Systems
text.description: Go backend engineering, concurrency (goroutines, channels), asynchronous pipelines, distributed system telemetry, alert automation, and production reliability.
text.additional_information: Hands-on experience from Google Cloud SQL SRE. Engineered high-throughput, parallelized Go pipelines for ticket enrichment and issue correlation across shared hosts, racks, and power buses. Developed generalized internal libraries for hardware data collection and metric processing. Implemented new production metrics for real-time validation, dynamic time-window adjustments, and reduced Root Cause Analysis (RCA) time for on-call SRE engineers in large-scale infrastructure.

text.title: DevOps, Tools & Operating Systems
text.description: Linux/Unix administration, Git/GitHub workflows, Bazel build systems, CI/CD, network protocols & security basics, and telemetry monitoring.
text.additional_information: Proficient in Linux environments, terminal navigation, process management, shell scripting, and core networking. Hands-on experience with Computer Networks & Security using Cisco Packet Tracer (subnetting, routing, security rules). Advanced Git/GitHub workflows (branching, PR reviews). Experienced with Bazel monorepos, web deployment on Render, environment secrets, and telemetry tools (Prometheus, metrics pipelines, log analytics).

text.title: Python & Django Framework
text.description: Full Django MVT with PostgreSQL and optimised ORM, CBVs and mixins, custom auth, middleware, signals and permissions, Celery, Redis and Stripe.
text.additional_information: Experienced with the full Django MVT structure (models, views, templates, forms, URL routing, built-in authentication system and ORM), PostgreSQL and optimisation ORM queries. Used Class-Based Views and mixins, customised user models, and created custom authentication backends. Worked with both built-in and custom middleware, signals, permissions and access control. Set up Celery with Redis for background tasks and used Redis for caching, and implemented Stripe for payments and checkout logic. Organised projects with modular architecture, customised the admin panel, managed static and media files, and created custom terminal management commands.

text.title: Databases & SQL Engineering
text.description: Relational database design (conceptual to physical), advanced SQL (joins, subqueries, aggregations), schema optimization, indexing, and ORM mapping.
text.additional_information: Experienced in relational database design (entities, ERD, 3NF normalization) and physical execution in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite. Confident writing complex SQL (multi-table JOINs, subqueries, group aggregations), optimizing queries via indexes, and configuring foreign key constraints. Worked with both raw SQL connections and ORMs (Django ORM, LowDB), managing migrations, transactional integrity, and SQL injection prevention.

text.title: Web Development & Node.js
text.description: Node.js & Express backends, modern JS, SSR, HTML5/CSS3 (Tailwind, Grid), UI/UX principles, REST APIs, and dynamic DOM manipulation.
text.additional_information: Experienced in building full-stack JS applications with Express and Node.js (Handlebars, LowDB, Cloudinary API). Applied UI/UX design fundamentals focusing on visual hierarchy, layout structure, and responsive interfaces. Proficient in semantic markup, dynamic state updates via Fetch API/async-await, Tailwind CSS, Semantic UI, and basic React component architecture.

text.title: Software Testing & Quality Assurance
text.description: Unit testing, End-to-End (E2E) integration testing, mock frameworks, edge-case coverage, dynamic stubs, and regression validation.
text.additional_information: Applied rigorous testing methodologies across multiple stacks. Engineered Go E2E test suites with mock servers to validate telemetry pipelines without production dependencies. Authored JUnit test suites in Java covering edge cases, collision handling in custom HashMaps, and sorting algorithms. Experienced with assertions, test runners, mocks, and stubs.

text.title: C# .NET MAUI
text.description: Cross-platform apps with XAML + MVVM: layouts, navigation, styles and resources, Two-Way binding,  SQLite and date/time handling.
text.additional_information: Experienced in developing cross-platform applications using XAML-based interfaces and the MVVM pattern to separate logic and presentation. Worked with multiple layouts to structure adaptive pages, implemented navigation between different screens and applied shared styling through resources. Used data binding (including TwoWay) to connect UI and ViewModels and wrote additional logic in code-behind where necessary. Integrated SQLite for storing and retrieving local data and worked with dates and timestamps.

text.title: Java & Core Data Structures
text.description: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Structures & Algorithms (Trees, Graphs, Sorting, Dynamic Programming), and JavaFX UIs.
text.additional_information: Strong foundation in Core Java, OOP principles, and fundamental Data Structures & Algorithms. Proficient in working with Trees (BST, AVL, Heaps), Graphs (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's), Hashing, Arrays, Linked Lists, and algorithmic paradigms like Greedy, Backtracking, and Dynamic Programming. To deeply understand low-level mechanics, implemented custom HashMaps with collision handling, linked lists, MergeSort, and iterators from scratch. Experienced in JavaFX desktop development, JSON file persistence, and writing thorough JUnit test suites.

text.title: Data Analytics
text.description: NumPy vectorisation, Pandas cleaning, merge, group, filter and Matplotlib for charts and exploratory analysis.
text.additional_information: Confident in using NumPy for numerical operations, vectorised calculations and array manipulation, and Pandas for working with tabular data, grouping, filtering, merging and cleaning datasets. Used Matplotlib to visualise trends, build charts and explore data patterns.

text.degree: Bachelor of Science in Software Systems Development
text.focus: Main focus is on software engineering process, tools, programming concepts, creative problem solving and UX design.

text.details: Finished school with almost the highest marks for final exams, participated in national and regional olympiads and technical competitions, consistently placing highly, including many 1st places.

items.title: Google SRE Intern - Cloud SQL SRE
items.short_description: Engineered a Go backend system to automatically enrich production alert tickets with hardware metadata and correlated issues for each attribute, significantly decreasing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigation time for on-call engineers. Navigated the complete software production lifecycle, from initial technical design documentation, peer reviews, and building reusable libraries to live production rollout, monitoring, and final presentation.
items.tech: Go (Golang), Bazel, Prometheus, Metrics & Telemetry Pipelines, Jira (Issue Tracking), Distributed Systems, SQL, Command-Line AI (Gemini), Cloud CLI, Linux (RHEL), Git

detailed_description.introduction: During my summer internship with the Cloud SQL SRE team at Google Dublin, I focused on improving incident response automation, system observability, and telemetry enrichment for large-scale cloud infrastructure.
features: Decreased Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigation time for on-call engineers by building a system that automatically enriches alert tickets with hardware metadata and correlates issues across shared hosts, racks, and power buses
Created a highly general Go library for hardware data collection that can be adopted both by other teams
Provided ability to easily add other attributes for correlation (not necessary hardware) by reusing existing methods
Designed a highly parallelized pipeline using Go-routines for asynchronous correlation, optimized database queries and created custom index
Created 2 new production metrics to monitor that our logic works as expected and dynamically adjust time windows to make logic more accurate and efficient
Created a plan to integrate the new package into our another existing system

Successfully navigated the full engineering lifecycle: created design document, addressed all comments and gained approvals, implemented all features on schedule, reviewed different comments on my change lists, and actively monitored the production rollout
Monitored in test environment and production analyzing logs and looking on different dashboards with my host and co-host

Actively extended the project's scope based on team feedback during design discussions. While the initial idea was to only correlate hostnames, I expanded the architecture to fetch and correlate multiple hardware attributes and generalized the logic so future attributes can be added seamlessly, also fetching logic was separated to another library which also was not planned initially
Refactored existing code to create common library that can be used at different places
Gained proficiency in contributing to a massive, pre-existing codebase
Implemented comprehensive end-to-end (e2e) tests utilizing mocking and stubbing techniques

items.title: Tech Shop
items.short_description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with multi-level categories, recommendation system, advanced search, Stripe integration, and admin management tools. Users can browse, filter, and purchase products, manage their profile and orders, or even create and sell their own products, all with real-time updates and notifications. Also there is a course system with ability to manage modules and contents.
items.tech: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Stripe API, HTML, CSS, JS (Vanilla + AJAX), Template Tags, Custom Middleware, Signals, Context Processors, Caching

detailed_description.introduction: This is a complex multi-purpose online shop built with Django, where users can browse, filter, and buy products, as well as manage their own sales and educational courses.
features: Structured multi-level categories and brands, where each big category has subcategories and brands have their pages with ability to subscribe for news.
Smart recommendation system that suggest similar products and popular products.

Advanced filtering for products in category that based on the existing characteristics, their values, brands and price range in that category, and advanced searching for products and categories with highlighting query.
Pagination and endless scroll for long lists.
Advanced product page that shows detailed info, has custom image modal viewer and reviews tab with ability to manage and filter them.
Logging and registration with ability to reset password, stay logged in for long time and sign in with Google.
Carts with full logic, including quantity control, stock limits, coupon system, checkout, Stripe and Stripe webhook integration for updating database.
Admin panel with ability to manage each item, search and export to CSV.
User profiles with many tabs with ability to add own products, manage them and view other people’s actions on them.
Courses platform with ability to add your own courses, fill in with modules and various content, mange order of content by dragging items and enrol other courses.
Asynchronous and optimized backend with background jobs, caching, different query optimisation, automatic and manual email sending and custom commands for terminal.

items.title: Task Manager
items.short_description: A cross-platform app for creating and managing tasks and corresponding exercises for each task. User can toggle completion status, set the order of exercises, see schedule in a calendar-view format and manage it. The UX is clear with colour-coded scheduling and different error preventions.
items.tech: C#, .Net MAUI, MVVM Architecture, SQLite percistance, XAML files, Asynchronous programming, Dependency injection, OOP

detailed_description.introduction: This project shows my ability to create multiplatform apps using .Net MAUI. This app has 3 main tabs: Current tasks, Completed tasks and Schedule, making it easier to organize work, track progress, and plan ahead.
features: Adding tasks and connected exercises and managing them in various ways, such as setting deadlines, priority for tasks, and dates and order for exercises, as well as toggling their completion status.
Smart schedule page: daily view with colour-coded exercises and automatic midnight updates.
Filtering and sorting of tasks by category, overdue statuses and other parameters.
Copy & paste functionality for exercises with a buffer implementation.
UX built with XAML layouts, multiple data bindings, value convertors and validation, including async updates, real-time status changes and error prevention.
Data storage in SQLite using .NET MAUI approach.

items.title: Movie Forum
items.short_description: An online platform for movie fans to create, play, and analyze film quizzes. Users can explore official and community quizzes, track global site statistics, and play with instant answer feedback and explanations. Creators can build custom quizzes with dynamic question flows, manage franchises, upload images, and monitor their profile performance and accuracy stats.
items.tech: Node.js, Express, Handlebars (Templating), JavaScript (Async/Await, Fetch API), Cloudinary API, LowDB, Tailwind CSS, Session Auth

detailed_description.introduction: This project was developed as a university assignment at SETU to demonstrate my skills in building full-stack web applications using Node.js and Express. The platform combines server-side rendering, real-time quiz mechanics, dynamic forms, and comprehensive analytics into a unified system.
features: Global & User Analytics Engines tracking total plays, average accuracy, hardest/trending quizzes, and individual user stats
Dynamic Quiz Builder enabling creators to add variable question flows with options, correct answers, and instant explanations
Full CRUD functionality for community-created quizzes and franchise categories with strict author authorization rules
Advanced filtering, searching, and sorting by difficulty, popularity, question count, and publication date
Interactive quiz playback featuring instant answer verification, immediate explanations, and completion scorecards
User Authentication & Profiles with session persistence via LowDB and custom avatar uploads integrated with Cloudinary API

items.title: Advertisement Agency
items.short_description: A full desktop app built with PyQt5 to manage clients, campaigns, advertisements, users, and media platforms. Admins can manage all tables with complete CRUD functionality (with error prevention), view related tables for each entity, while clients can add new campaigns and generate reports, and users can see advertisements linked to their media platforms.
items.tech: SQL (pyodbc), Python, PyQt5, MVC, OOP, PDF/Excel generation

detailed_description.introduction: This is a desktop app (built with PyQt5) developed as my university assignment that shows my skill in database manipulation and building a complete application for real-world data interaction. It combines several user roles, each has different rights and capabilities.
features: MVC architecture and different design patterns for clean structure, maintainability, and data control.
Full CRUD functionality for all entities with robust validation and error handling.
Role-based access (admin, client, user) defining available features and permissions.
Detailed entity pages displaying all related tables with ability to add new or existing linked records.
Automated updates of related data and entity dependencies.
Sorting, filtering, searching, and smooth navigation between connected tables.
Raw SQL queries with full SQL injection protection and encapsulated connection lifecycle.
PDF/Excel report generation and real-time ad metrics tracking.
Simple users can view their related media platforms and corresponding advertisements.

items.title: Bakery System
items.short_description: A JavaFX desktop app to manage baked goods and ingredients catalogs. Users can explore linked items, use exact or keyword search, sort and edit data, manage unit measurements, and persist state via JSON files. Built using custom Data Structures & Algorithms with JUnit testing.
items.tech: Java, JavaFX, Custom Data Structures (HashMap, SinglyLinkedList), Custom MergeSort, JUnit, OOP, DSA, JSON

detailed_description.introduction: This project was developed as a collaborative assignment at SETU for the Data Structures & Algorithms module. It combines a rich JavaFX desktop UI with custom-built engine logic, where core data structures, sorting algorithms, and searches were implemented from scratch without standard library collections.
features: Engineered custom Data Structures from scratch, including a custom HashMap with collision resolution, SinglyLinkedList, and custom Iterators
Implemented O(1) exact match lookup via custom Hash Map and multi-criteria keyword search across names, descriptions, origins, and linked ingredients
Custom MergeSort implementation enabling dynamic sorting by names, origins, and calorie counts (ascending and descending)
Full CRUD functionality for baked goods and ingredients with bidirectional relationship linking and circular navigation protection
Persistent data storage via JSON files with full state saving, loading, and resetting capabilities
Comprehensive JUnit unit test suites covering core algorithms, custom structures, edge cases, and collision handling
